name: Treaty of Stralsund
summary: Denmark concedes to the Hanseatic League after defeat in the Danish-Hanseatic War (1368–70). The League gains 15% of Danish Sound dues, four Scanian fortresses for 15 years, and veto power over Danish royal elections. The treaty is the Hansa's diplomatic high-water mark.

_quarry.structural_significance: Cements the Hanseatic League's commercial monopoly over the Baltic and North Sea for the next century; institutionalises a non-territorial commercial confederation as a Great Power in Northern European diplomacy.
